subject: Next steps: technical deep-dive & rotating windows for demo
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@clearmed.io>, Tom Gupta <tom.gupta@clearmed.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: technical deep-dive & rotating windows for demo

Hi Sophie / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on your ingestion patterns and the two latency-sensitive flows you called out (real-time triage + nightly bulk indexing). Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the deep-dive: 

- Recap: ClearMed needs sub-100ms 99th percentile for triage, and predictable per-token cost for nightly indexing. You have an on-prem GKE cluster and a separate analytics cluster in eu-west.
- Goal for deep-dive: run through an end-to-end demo using a representative payload, confirm routing/fallback options for hybrid infra, and validate cost-per-request assumptions.

Proposed approach: schedule a 75-minute technical deep-dive (30m demo, 30m architecture + deployment Qs, 15m action plan). Because your team spans US/EU/APAC, we suggest a 3-week rotating meeting window so the same group can attend over time without always meeting at one timezone's inconvenient hour. Sample rotation (all times in UTC with local conversions):

Week A (US-friendly): Tue 17:00 UTC (Tue 10:00 PT / Tue 13:00 ET / Tue 18:00 CET / Wed 02:00 SGT)
Week B (EU-friendly): Thu 09:00 UTC (Thu 01:00 PT / Thu 04:00 ET / Thu 10:00 CET / Thu 17:00 SGT)
Week C (APAC-friendly): Wed 02:00 UTC (Tue 19:00 PT / Tue 22:00 ET / Wed 03:00 CET / Wed 10:00 SGT)

If that rotation looks reasonable we can set a recurring invite and rotate hosts internally so the core technical owners on both sides can alternate. Attached: short discovery recap and a proposed demo agenda.

Actions I need from you:
- Confirm whether a rotating weekly cadence works for ClearMed (or suggest alternate cadence).
- Who from your side needs to attend (esp. CISO / infra owner / data engineering).
- Any blackout dates for June/July.

I’ll loop Karthik in to propose an internal rotation that maps to our tech leads.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Attachments: clearmed_discovery-recaps.pdf, demo-agenda.md
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@clearmed.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Gupta <tom.gupta@clearmed.io>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 08:25:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep-dive & rotating windows for demo

Hi Evelyn —

Appreciate the clear recap. The rotating approach makes sense in principle — our team is distributed and we want to avoid always asking the same small subset to join. A few quick notes from our side:

- Preferred meeting cadence: weekly works for us as long as it's predictable and recorded.
- Attendees: myself (Product), Tom (Infra lead) and we should include Sarah King (CISO) for the security section. Sarah prefers mornings CET.
- Availability constraints: June 16–20 we have a product freeze; otherwise June mornings (08:00–12:00 CET) are generally best for our core group.

Specific ask: could you propose a rotation that keeps most EU-facing sessions in the 08:00–12:00 CET window at least 50% of the time?

We use Google Calendar — if you want to send a recurring invite/Cal link that we can accept, that’d be easiest.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Martin
Head of Product | ClearMed
sophie.martin@clearmed.io
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@clearmed.io>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Gupta <tom.gupta@clearmed.io>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 11:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep-dive & rotating windows for demo

Hi all —

Nice to meet you virtually, Sophie & Tom — I’m Karthik on the Redwood infra team. Per Evelyn’s note and Sophie’s preference to keep EU mornings frequent, here’s a pragmatic rotation that balances EU coverage while still sharing pain across timezones:

3-week rotating schedule (weekly recurring, then rotates):
- Week 1 (EU-priority): Thu 09:30 UTC (Thu 11:30 CET / Thu 03:30 PT) — fits Sarah/Karl for mornings
- Week 2 (US-priority): Tue 16:30 UTC (Tue 09:30 PT / Tue 12:30 ET / Wed 01:30 SGT)
- Week 3 (APAC-priority): Wed 01:00 UTC (Tue 18:00 PT / Tue 21:00 ET / Wed 02:00 CET / Wed 09:00 SGT)

Notes:
- We’ll keep the session length at 75 minutes and record each meeting.
- Ben will own the deep dive content for infra/latency/cost. I attached our tech-deepdive-checklist so you can see topics we want to cover (networking, KV cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs, fallback routing).
- If Sarah (CISO) can’t attend a session, we’ll capture security-specific artifacts ahead of time and have a follow-up 30-min slot.

If that looks good I can send the recurring invite as a rotation (I’ll include a Calendly/Cal link if you prefer a poll).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Attachments: tech-deepive-checklist.pdf

Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep-dive & rotating windows for demo

Thanks — I’ll take point on the deep-dive content and demo flow. Small logistics:

- I’ve created a short Calendly poll for ClearMed to pick an initial slot: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/clearmed-tech-deep-dive
- Also dropping a Doodle if you prefer a multi-option poll: https://doodle.com/poll/3way-rotator-clearmed
- I’ll include an agenda and our reproducible payload so you can validate locally before the call.

Evelyn / Karthik — I’ll schedule the first three occurrences (one per rotation week) as tentative and mark them as \"rotating\": we can finalize after Sophie confirms Sarah’s availability.

Best,
Ben Carter
Staff Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
